headline: Sawyer Arena opening update, fall recreation programming, waterfront event scheduling, and ongoing project status.
summary: The committee will review the Sawyer Arena opening for the 2026/27 season, discuss current fall recreation programming, go over permitted waterfront events and 2027 season scheduling, and get an update on ongoing projects.
items: Sawyer Arena Update and Preview: opening for the 2026/27 season and the Parks and Recreation Department's role with School Department athletic facilities
Recreation Program Discussion: review of current fall programming
Waterfront/Event Season Discussion: overview of permitted events and scheduling update for the 2027 season
Project Update: status of ongoing projects
location: City Council Chambers, City Hall, 73 Harlow Street
plain_text:
Parks, Recreation and Harbor 
 
Advisory Committee 
 
October 9, 2025 
 
City Council Chambers 
 
City Hall 
 
73 Harlow Street 
 
 
AGENDA 
 
Approval of September meeting minutes 
 
Sawyer Arena Update and Preview  
  
Staff will be discussing with the committee the opening of Sawyer Arena for the 
2026/27 season.  Also included in the update will be an overview of the role of 
the Parks and Recreation Department with the School Department athletic 
facilities.   
 
Recreation Program Discussion 
  
The fall programming season is well underway.  The department has offered its 
traditional fall activities along with some new programming options.  We will be 
discussing with the committee the current fall programming. 
 
Waterfront/Event Season Discussion 
 
The department continues to manage and permit events that utilize City property 
and facilities.  Staff will overview the permitted events throughout the season and 
update scheduling for the 2027 season. 
 
Project Update 
  
Staff has been reviewing ongoing projects with the Committee and this 
discussion will be an update on the status. 
 
Other Business 
 
Adjourn
